data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A-stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, having raised $27M+ to date. The addressable comp universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 2 private peers (Boom Supersonic, Hermeus), though the narrow stage and sector focus limits direct comparables.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $27M total raised as a valuation proxy. This method, calibrated to typical Series A advancement dynamics, implies a post-round valuation of $54M. No Peer-Median approach could be deployed given insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector; applying an all-sector median would introduce material cross-sector bias.

The triangulated valuation range spans $46M (low) to $62M (high), with a median of $54M. This narrow $16M band reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than robust cross-validation. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for Astro Mechanica's specific risk and growth profile, and the absence of direct peer valuation anchors within the sector. Material data gaps—particularly pre-Series A momentum indicators and comparable recent Series A rounds in Supersonic & Hypersonic—constrain conviction in this range. Updated analysis would benefit from additional private-market transaction data or narrower-stage peer coverage.
